brief_regeneration.baseline_headline: September 30 answered the frame's open question with firm numbers: GDP was revised up 0.7pp to 2.2% and core PCE still runs at 3.0% y/y, so growth is not cracking even as inflation stays sticky — and both boards still sit just above policy with no verifiable meeting distribution. Friday's September payrolls is now the single scheduled swing factor before the October decisions.
brief_regeneration.candidate_headline: October's first data day leaned hawkish: ISM held expansion at 54.5 but prices-paid spiked to 77.9, claims stayed low at 197k, and the street's October-hike chatter (media-reported above 70% per CME FedWatch — not verifiable from here) hardened — with our own direct pricing still dark. September payrolls at 08:30 ET today is the adjudicator.
